title: AgentForge Clinical Co-Pilot Requirements (Ingested from PDF)
scope_summary: Defines product requirements and delivery gates for a production-ready OpenEMR Clinical Co-Pilot with role-safe access, verifiable outputs, security compliance, and clinical-speed responses.
key_decisions_or_requirements: Enforce role-based access boundaries in multi-user healthcare environments.
Require traceable source attribution and domain constraint checks before responses are shown.
Optimize architecture for clinical-time responses while explicitly documenting speed/completeness tradeoffs.
Apply PHI/HIPAA constraints across storage, transmission, logging, and access control.
Implement explicit, safe degradation for tool failures and incomplete records.
Complete MVP foundation gates: local and public OpenEMR deployment plus AUDIT.md, USERS.md, and ARCHITECTURE.md artifacts.
Provide observability and evaluation coverage for happy paths, failures, regressions, and unauthorized-access attempts.
